## WF06 – RFQ manager (core)
Processes one conversation at a time (DB lock → strict ordering, no duplicate RFQs when WhatsApp messages arrive in bursts).

**Route**: reply to a sent quote → WF14 · otherwise classify (WF03) →
* quote intents → extract (WF04) → deterministic merge → create/update RFQ → priority (WF07) → ready? route to desk (WF09) + acknowledgement : ask missing info (WF05)
* change / cancel / refund → WF15
* anything else → human review (+ KB suggestions, security flag)

Every minute a sweeper requeues failed messages (backoff) and picks up orphans.
